title: `upsampled_count()` drops the `ifNull` default, silently reverting defensive logic
description: commit `6ad6fe38` changes `sum(ifNull(sample_weight, 1))` → `sum(sample_weight)`, silently reverting the defensive default. Events without `sample_weight` count as zero instead of one, causing projects to report count() == 0 for all historical error volume.

title: Stray `sentry-repo` gitlink committed with no `.gitmodules`
description: `6ad6fe38` adds mode 160000 entry `sentry-repo` without `.gitmodules`, causing every fresh clone to get an empty directory and `git submodule update --init` to fail.

title: 60s eligibility cache is slower than original and cannot be invalidated
description: Cache swaps local dict read for network cache round-trip on every request, making it slower. Functionally non-revertible: when projects are removed from allowlist, endpoint keeps returning upsampled counts for up to 60s per distinct project-subset.

title: Negated `!event.type:error` queries misclassified as error-focused
description: `_is_error_focused_query` does substring test, so `!event.type:error` (negation) is incorrectly classified as error-focused, causing non-error rows without `sample_weight` to report count as 0.

title: Endpoint refactor triples line count with no behavior change
description: Replaces two lines with an inert alias and three identical copies of the same `if`/transform in each return branch, creating three places to keep in sync.
